youtube_description:
It's time for Americans to demonstrate our resilience, our strength, and our ability to lead by example.

🇺🇸 The United States of America is a Nation more divided than ever. The issues faced by our people have never been greater. What happened to the United States? Is there a way we, the people, can remember who we are and restore the greatness of our nation? 

🔴 It's time for Americans to Unite, Show our Greatness and Make the American Dream a reality! 

✅ Mark Your Calendars for the significant event of the year. September 24th, 2022 11AM EST “Global Crisis. USA”. 

Across the country, the American people are unifying to promote the idea of Creative Society and show how the life of each person can be improved and how we can build a Strong United Country.
